description: This script manages the syslog service, including starting, stopping, and restarting syslog with specific configurations, handling log levels, remote logging, and syslog rotation.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Initializes syslog service, sets log levels, configures remote logging, and starts syslog daemon.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops syslog daemon and cleans up related files.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes configuration variables by retrieving log level and remote log settings.
